newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes 1.25 lower at 995.25.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes 1.25 lower at 995.25.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 1.25 lower at 995.25 per dollar as sporadic demand for the U.S. currency took some of the shine off the local currency in active trading on the country's interbank market.
Dealers said dollar sales by oil exporters put upward pressure on the peso in early trading, but demand for dollars by banks and importers cut the peso's gains in late trading.
Dealers reported 341 trades for a total of $126 million and said the peso hit an intra-day high of 993.95 before closing at its low for the day at 995.25.
